name: Dal Dhokli
instructions: 1. Cook dal with turmeric. 2. Make a spiced wheat dough and roll into thin squares (dhokli). 3. Add dhokli to the boiling dal. 4. Add peanuts, kokum, and jaggery. 5. Simmer until the dhokli is cooked.
description: Soft wheat dumplings swimming in a sweet, spicy, and tangy lentil sea.
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
